start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep the sign-in codes my proof accounts were just sent." It runs tool:keep-the-proof-accounts-sign-in-codes with the asked_at step ask answered.
no_lists_because: Its only state is vault values (proof-sessions, proof-sign-in-code), never rows; the proof accounts are the Workshop DATA proof-accounts.json.
instructions: 1. The vault holds agentmail-api-key (bound to mcp.agentmail.to) and proof-sign-in-code (put once, bound to the sites' hosts).
2. Run the tool with asked_at from step ask.
3. It reads each newest code from the proof inbox and puts the codes as proof-sign-in-code. The answer names the origins kept and missing; it never holds a code.
